name: HQ FPS Weapons
author: lolgg313
description: First-person weapons by lolgg313, brought over from the author's own Unity project. 20 GPU-skinned viewmodels sharing a 44-bone arm rig with bare-skin (Arm_Standard) hands: 11 firearms, 3 melee, 2 throwables, plus tools and unarmed. Original baked animation clips (Draw, Idle, Hold, Fire, AimFire, Reload, ReloadEmpty, Holster and weapon-specific variants) are preserved as glTF animations. Includes 183 original weapon, impact and surface sound effects. Assets: free in Heaven3D games only, no redistribution of the raw files (see ASSETS_LICENSE.md).
